title: Broque Monsieur! ✨🧱
description: Broque Monsieur arrives to Minecraft as a full resource pack/DLC! 🎮
body:
Straight from Mario & Luigi: Bowser’s Inside Story, the eccentric **Broque Monsieur** arrives to Minecraft as a full **resource pack/DLC!** 🎮


This pack completely **replaces the Maw-Maw** – both its **model and sounds** – with Broque Monsieur, bringing his quirky personality right into your world.


**⚔️ Features inspired by his training battle against Bowser:**


✅ Unique animations with his iconic **“?” block attack**


✅ Transformation where he grows enormous to strike


✅ Head-turning pursuit animations, just like when he chases Bowser & friends


Now you can experience Minecraft battles with all the charm (and chaos) of this unforgettable character! 💥


_**///About Mod///**_

This is an altered version of the original model made by YoshiMaker of MawMaw,
which replaces him with Broque Monsieur.

[https://discord.com/invite/pQnwM4gu8M](https://discord.com/invite/pQnwM4gu8M)


-Custom texture pack (x32)

-Models made in Blockbench

-Download the required packs for non missing textures

-Inspiration straight from Mario and Luigi Bowser Inside Story

**-You need the [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DL1VjkEFyoeZCSgjl-FG8FJR-bdCMspZ/view]**
